invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null HoodieWriteConfig to function, otherwise it may throw NullPointerException.
By the method signature, config is always a HoodieWriteConfig.
The factory method createKeyGenerator expects non-null properties; config.getProps() should not be null.
Option is used in the return type; it must be available and loadable.
BaseKeyGenerator is casted and used; it must be available and loadable.
